name: approval-chain
description: Two-level human approval: manager review, then finance sign-off above an amount threshold, then a callback with the final decision.
author: orch8-io
requires: Reviewers answer through the approvals inbox (dashboard, `/api/v1/approvals`, or the mobile SDK).
context.data: request_id, summary, amount (number), finance_threshold (number), callback_url.
An unanswered review times out after 48h (manager) / 72h (finance); adjust wait_for_input.timeout to your policy.
